purpose: H12-A minimal Entry Filter — keep only Z1 gain<=4.5 (DD-control with explicit DD evidence). All other 13 rules dropped per H12-A research (each cost 0-36pp on 3yr without DD evidence). Apply AFTER ML threshold gate, BEFORE top-1 selection.

Z1.description: DD-control gain cap (gain≤4.5 added 2026-06-04 for blocking AXTI/FSLR-style high-gain entries that take deep intraday DD; recent 1mo: avgDD -1.10→-0.60, p10DD -1.93→-0.99, bad%(DD<-2) 10→0; 3yr cost: sum -8% / -1.3pp acceptable for DD reduction)

Z2.description: NO entry filter rules — stack-model + cell filter + regime gate handle selection

Z3.description: NO entry filter rules — cell filter + skip Fri + sec>0 handle selection

Z4.description: NO entry filter rules — Option E* (VIX-conditional + sector-aware SPY) handles selection

graceful_fallback: If a required feature is missing (NaN/None) → treat as PASS (don't drop). Engine continues normal selection.
env_toggle: ENTRY_FILTER_ENABLED (default=1). Set to 0 to disable instantly without code change. ENTRY_FILTER_SPEC=v2-h12a to enable this spec instead of v1.
rollback: Restore spec.pre_h12a.json (backed up automatically) or `git reset --hard v1.9.0-pre-h12a` + restart auto-trading.service
